title: Fix Procedural 3D Preview Tessellation
description: Nothing previews in 3D in procedural (sphere, torus). Root cause: flow eval creates geometry handles in flow_core WASM but tessellation uses standalone module-brep WASM with a separate kernel.
summary: Removed leftover [DEBUG] console.debug in serializeGraphVelloThemePaletteJson. It flooded the console because flow/procedural syncVelloTheme runs every animation frame via renderFrame.
